scientific_integrity: Finite exact-rational experiments corroborate the statement but are not its proof. The proof is a finite counting argument plus an analytic growth inequality. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Uniform permutations only. The exact marked-cycle covariance reduction and complete sign law do not supply a closed elementary formula for expected maximum length. The macroscopic consequence uses the classical Golomb–Dickman limit. An equivalent earlier specialized transform remains a literature risk. The earliest public antecedent date is the 1965-09-02 Society presentation explicitly recorded in Shepp and Lloyd (1966), rather than its 1966 journal issue date.
title: A Golomb–Dickman sign boundary for longest-cycle and cycle-count dependence
